subject: POC Kickoff + Hands-on: prompt review, routing & load trial — convening availability
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@edgebank.com>, Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@edgebank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Kickoff + Hands-on: prompt review, routing & load trial — convening availability

Hi Liam / Sophie —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our conversation, the best next step is a 90-minute POC kickoff that pairs a short 20-minute context/expectations sync with a 60-minute hands-on workshop: prompt review, routing policy walkthrough, and a short load trial to validate latency and KV cache behavior. Goal is to leave with a mutual action plan and acceptance criteria.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed Apr 7 — 10:00–11:30
- Thu Apr 8 — 13:00–14:30
- Mon Apr 12 — 09:00–10:30

Attachments: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf (agenda + success criteria), Prompt_Set_EdgeBank.xlsx (sample prompts & use-cases), routing-topology.png (current routing sketch). I'll also drop a shared Drive link.

Pre-reads / asks:
- Please confirm which product owners will attend and who is the technical lead for routing/SSO.
- If you have a tenant or model constraints (on-prem VPC, data-retention), flag them now so we shape the lab.

If none of these slots work, happy to propose more. Once we lock time we'll send a calendar invite with an ICS and a short prep doc.

Thanks — looking forward to getting hands-on.

Best,
Vivek
VP, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
attachments: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf, Prompt_Set_EdgeBank.xlsx, routing-topology.png

Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff + Hands-on: prompt review, routing & load trial — convening availability

Vivek —

Thanks, that looks good. We prefer afternoons PT because of our leadership schedule. Thu Apr 8 13:00–14:30 PT works for our core team. Attending from EdgeBank: me (product), Sophie (integration lead), and I will try to get our infra lead (Marcus Chen) to join — he may dial in late.

A couple of quick items:
- We need to confirm SSO and network access: will you need a temporary egress rule opened from our test VPC for model variants / telemetry?
- For the load trial, keep it light — just enough to validate latency under a small burst (100 reqs/min). We don't want sustained large runs on our staging network.

If you can add a one-page prep with the minimal access requirements (ports, IP ranges, credentials), that would help us spin up the test window quickly.

Liam
Product Manager, EdgeBank
liam.oconnell@edgebank.com

Liam — great, Thu Apr 8 13:00–14:30 PT is locked for now. I'll send a calendar invite with an ICS (meeting-invite.ics) and the short prep note.

Answers to your questions:
- Network: for the light load trial we only need outbound HTTPS to our ephemeral inference gateway. I'll include the exact IP ranges and FQDNs in the prep doc; no inbound holes required.
- SSO: not required for the lab itself. If you want to enable tenant isolation we can demo how to pin a model variant to your VPC, but it's optional for the kickoff.

Attached: quick prep one-pager (attached here as POC_Agenda_v1.pdf with an Appendix describing minimal access), and the prompt set. Karthik will lead the hands-on portion and Neha will cover success criteria and acceptance checks.

Karthik / Neha — can you both review the prompts and call out any routing items we should highlight (e.g., latency SLOs per route, cache-warm strategy)?

Thanks — will follow up with the invite and Drive link.

Best,
Vivek

Hi all — quick scheduling note: our CRO has a travel conflict that day and has asked to move the session by one day if possible so he can join the opening 20 minutes for the success-criteria alignment. Can we shift to Fri Apr 9 10:00–11:30 PT or Mon Apr 12 09:00–10:30 PT (both slots Vivek had originally proposed)?

If EdgeBank prefers Thu afternoon we can still run without the CRO in the first 20, but he strongly prefers to be present for the acceptance criteria portion.

Liam / Sophie — which of the two alternate slots would you prefer? If neither works we'll keep Thu and Marissa will join via recording plus a short sync with you afterwards.

Thanks — Marissa
